accepted: The research team published its results online.
Online, the research team published its results.
W01.explanation:
读懂：研究团队把研究结果发布到了网上，回答的是他们对结果做了什么。
解析：先找做事的人 the research team，再接已经做过的事 published（发布了），后面是 its results（它的研究结果）。online 表示发布地点，不是被发布的东西；不要把 its results 和团队的位置交换。参考也接受 Online 放句首，意思不变。
下次：先连成“团队—发布了—结果”，再加“在网上”。题目问过去发生的事，沿用 published，不照搬问句里的 did；最后检查四块词都已放入。

accepted: Students can reserve a study room through the library.
Through the library, students can reserve a study room.
W02.explanation:
读懂：学生可以通过图书馆预订自习室；问题要的是预订途径。
解析：students 是谁，can reserve 是“可以预订”，a study room 是预订对象，through the library 是“通过图书馆”。can 后直接用 reserve；does 是多余词块，不能再插入 can 和动作之间。表示途径的整块放句尾或句首都在可接受答案中。
下次：先排“学生—可以预订—自习室”，再安放途径。认准 can 已表达“可以”，不要看到词库中的 does 就硬用；移动 through the library 时保留整块含义。

accepted: Because the trail was wet, the class walked slowly.
The class walked slowly because the trail was wet.
Because the trail was wet, the class slowly walked.
The class slowly walked because the trail was wet.
W03.explanation:
读懂：因为小路湿了，全班走得很慢；要说明慢走的原因。
解析：the trail was wet 是“小路是湿的”，the class walked slowly 是“全班慢慢走”。was 要与 wet 连起来，不能让小路 walked 或把全班写成 was wet。because 引出原因，可以把原因放前面，也可以放在结果后；slowly 放 walked 前后均有被接受的词序。
下次：先分别拼好“小路湿”和“全班慢走”两件事，再把 because 接到原因前。读一遍检查因果方向，不要只记住参考句某一个位置排列。

accepted: Our professor asked whether the evidence supported the claim.
W04.explanation:
读懂：教授问的是“这些证据是否支持这个论点”，不是断言论点已经得到证明。
解析：固定开头 Our professor 后接 asked（问了），whether 表示“是否”。教授问的内容按 the evidence supported the claim 排，即“证据—支持了—论点”，不改成直接提问的倒序。词块 did 是干扰，不能拼成 whether did the evidence supported。
下次：先完成“教授问了”，再把“证据支持论点”作为一个完整想法接在 whether 后。遇到“某人想知道是否……”时，里面先放谁、再放动作。

accepted: The new schedule allows commuters to avoid rush hour.
W05.explanation:
读懂：新时刻表使通勤者能够避开交通高峰，说明它给往返上班的人带来的帮助。
解析：the new schedule 是单个时刻表，后接 allows；allows commuters to avoid 是“让通勤者能够避开”。题面已经固定 commuters，不能把它当成要再找的词块。to avoid 要连到被允许的人后面，rush hour（高峰时段）是避开的对象，不要排成 allows to avoid commuters。
下次：用“什么安排—让谁—能够做什么”来排。本题先放时刻表和 allows，借固定的 commuters 接 to avoid，最后放 rush hour。

accepted: After the experiment, we recorded each measurement carefully.
We recorded each measurement carefully after the experiment.
We carefully recorded each measurement after the experiment.
After the experiment, we carefully recorded each measurement.
Carefully, we recorded each measurement after the experiment.
W06.explanation:
读懂：实验之后，我们仔细记下了每一项测量结果，既有时间，也有做事方式。
解析：we recorded each measurement 是“我们记录了每项测量”。recorded 已经是过去做的动作，干扰块 was 不应插进去。carefully（仔细地）可放 recorded 前、测量对象后，参考也接受放句首；after the experiment 可置于句首或句尾，已列出的这些变体都保留相同意思。
下次：先拼“我们—记录了—每项测量”，再加时间和方式。不把 each measurement 拆散，也不要为了用完词库加入 was。

accepted: The museum will display photographs from the early expedition.
W07.explanation:
读懂：博物馆将展出早期考察活动留下的照片；要说清展品是什么以及照片的来源。
解析：the museum 是做事的一方，will display 整块表示“将展出”，photographs 是展出对象。from 要紧接照片并连到题面固定的 the early expedition，合起来是“来自早期考察的照片”；不是博物馆从考察中来到这里。不要把 photographs 放到 will display 前面当主角。
下次：按“博物馆—将展出—照片—来自哪次考察”串起来。先看固定句尾，再找能连接它的 from，避免遗漏来源。

accepted: If the weather improves, the market will open outside.
The market will open outside if the weather improves.
W08.explanation:
读懂：如果天气转好，集市就会在户外开市；户外营业是有条件的，不是已经确定发生。
解析：if the weather improves 说“如果天气改善”，the market will open outside 说可能的后续安排。这里 if 后用 improves 表达未来条件，不需要再放 will；主句用 will open。would 是本题多余词块。参考允许条件放句首，也允许整段移到句尾。
下次：先划分“天气条件”和“集市安排”，将 if 配天气、will 配 open，再放 outside。不要把 would 与 will 一起塞入，也不要丢掉条件。

accepted: Many languages borrow words when cultures come into contact.
When cultures come into contact, many languages borrow words.
W09.explanation:
读懂：不同文化发生接触时，许多语言会借用词汇，说的是一种常见现象。
解析：many languages borrow words 是“许多语言借用词汇”；cultures come into contact 是“文化发生接触”。when 连接这两件事，不能让 words 去 come into contact，也不要把 cultures 当成借来的词。when 这一整段放句首或句尾都可接受，borrow 保持原形，因为说的是多种语言的普遍情况。
下次：先确定每个动作由谁完成，再用 when 连接。把 come into contact 当“发生接触”整块记住，勿按中文逐字重排。

accepted: The advisor recommended that I compare several sources.
W10.explanation:
读懂：导师建议我比较几个资料来源，重点是建议做什么，而不是说我已经比较完了。
解析：固定 The advisor 后放 recommended，再接 that I compare several sources。that 后说明建议的具体内容：“我比较几个来源”。这里表达建议时用 compare，不因 recommended 是过去形式就随意改词。词库里的 to 是干扰，不能拼成 that I to compare。
下次：先搭“导师建议—具体建议内容”两层；看到 that 后先放 I，再放 compare 和对象。把 several sources 理解为“多个来源”，核对没有漏掉比较对象。

W11.reference:
Dear Professor Lee,

I am writing about the statistics appointment that was moved to Thursday afternoon. Unfortunately, I have a required chemistry class at the new time, so I cannot attend without missing an assessed laboratory activity.

Could we meet on Friday morning or during your next available office hour? I would like help deciding which statistical test is appropriate for my project. I have compared the examples in our textbook, but I am still uncertain because my two groups contain different numbers of participants.

I can send you my research question and a short summary of the data beforehand. Thank you for considering another appointment.

Best regards,
Alex
W11.explanation:
读懂：统计项目的面谈改期后与你的必修课冲突。给 Lee 教授写信，说明不能赴约的原因、项目哪里需帮助，并请求另约时间和说明如何提前准备。
解析：范文用必修实验说明冲突，具体问两组人数不同该选什么统计检验，再提周五或办公时间，愿提前发研究问题与数据摘要，覆盖三项要求。reschedule 是“重新安排时间”。只道歉请改期，会漏掉咨询内容和准备办法；示例日期不必照搬。
下次：按“原约与冲突→一个统计难点→可行新时间→提前发什么材料”写。用礼貌请求而非要求教授迁就，并检查收信人能据此决定下一步。

W12.reference:
Dear Housing Office,

I am a resident of Willow Hall, and I would like to report a problem in our laundry room. Machines two and four stop shortly after starting, even when a small load is selected. Several residents have experienced the same problem since Monday evening.

With only two working machines, the waiting time is especially long after classes. Could your maintenance team inspect the broken machines and post an estimated repair date?

As a temporary solution, would it be possible for our residents to use the laundry room in Maple Hall? A sign explaining that arrangement would help people avoid unnecessary trips.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Alex
W12.explanation:
读懂：宿舍两台洗衣机失灵，其他住户也洗衣困难。写给住宿办公室，交代故障及影响、请求检查维修，并提出维修期间的临时办法。
解析：范文描述启动后停止、课后排队时间长，随后询问检查和预计修复日期，建议借用另一栋宿舍洗衣房并张贴指引。temporary solution 是“临时解决办法”，不能只催快修却不给过渡安排；也别把借用邻楼写成已获批准。
下次：分“可观察的故障→影响多少人或什么时段→维修请求→待批准的替代设施”四步。机器编号等可用自洽示例，不必复制范文楼名，重点是让工作人员能调查和回复。

W13.reference:
Dear Media Desk Team,

I borrowed camera number 18 for my environmental science project, and it is currently due back on Wednesday. May I request an extension until Friday afternoon?

Our project involves photographing activity at the campus garden. Heavy rain forced us to postpone the final session, and Thursday is the first day when all our participants are available again. Two additional days would allow us to complete the work and check that the images were saved correctly.

I understand that another student may have reserved the camera. If an extension would affect that reservation, please let me know whether a different device is available instead.

Thank you for considering my request.

Best regards,
Alex
W13.explanation:
读懂：课题照片尚未完成，借来的相机要多用两天。写给媒体服务台，说明借用信息与延期请求、项目为何需要额外时间，并询问无法续借时的替代办法。
解析：范文用相机编号和原到期日定位借用，再解释雨天延误拍摄、需要补拍及检查照片；若影响别人预约，则询问其他设备。extension 指“延长借期”。只说项目没做完不够具体，也不能默认可占用他人已订设备。
下次：按“哪台相机何时到期→明确多借两天→这两天完成什么→续借不行怎么办”写。新归还时间应与两天相符，语气保持请求而不是通知。

W14.reference:
Hi Jamie,

A visiting researcher is giving a talk about urban gardens in the science building on Tuesday evening. Would you like to come with me? The event begins at six, and students can attend without registering.

I thought the talk would be useful for your project on neighborhood development. The researcher studies how shared gardens affect access to fresh food and create opportunities for residents to meet. Those examples could help you connect the environmental and social parts of your argument.

There will also be time for questions, so you could ask how the team measures community participation. We could meet outside the building at five forty-five if you are free.

Let me know what you think!

Alex
W14.explanation:
读懂：邀请同学 Jamie 一起听城市花园研究讲座，要提供有用活动信息、联系其当前项目，并约定一同参加的安排，不能只转发广告。
解析：范文给出地点、开始时间与报名信息，说明社区花园如何连接新鲜食物与邻里交往，能帮助同学的社区发展课题，再约楼外碰面。attend together 是“一起参加”。只称讲座有趣而没说明项目用途，会漏掉邀请的针对性；活动细节是示例。
下次：先邀请并交代时间地点，再说明同学项目中的一个问题能从讲座获得什么，最后给出集合方案并询问是否有空，别写成对教授的正式申请。

W15.reference:
Dear Ms. Rivera,

Thank you for organizing next week's field trip. I have read the directions, but I am unsure about the meeting point. The email mentions the science building, while the attached schedule lists the south gate. Could you confirm which location we should use and what time we need to arrive?

I would also appreciate some guidance about what to bring. Will we need waterproof shoes and a notebook, or will the activity take place entirely on paved paths? Please let us know whether lunch and drinking water will be provided.

Clarifying these details would help me prepare and avoid delaying the group on the morning of the trip.

Best regards,
Alex
W15.explanation:
读懂：实地考察通知没说清集合安排，你也不知道带什么。写信说明哪里不清楚，确认集合地点和到达时间，并问自带用品与主办方提供物品。
解析：范文指出邮件和附件分别写科学楼、南门，从具体矛盾引出确认请求；接着问鞋、笔记本以及是否提供午餐饮水。provided 是“由对方提供”。只问集合地点会漏时间，只问要带什么又会漏供应情况，不能凭猜测选一个地点。
下次：按“我读到的疑点→请确认地点与到达时间→我可能需带什么→哪些由组织者提供”写。把发问整理成便于逐一回复的完整句，避免大段抱怨通知不清。

W16.reference:
Hi Morgan,

I have been thinking about attendance at our student club meetings. Several members have told me that they enjoy the activities but find it difficult to stay for the long announcements at the beginning.

Could we try a different format for the next two meetings? We could share routine updates in a short email beforehand and begin with a small group activity. Members would then have a clear reason to arrive on time and more opportunities to participate.

We could keep ten minutes at the end for questions about the announcements. After two meetings, a quick survey would show whether the change improved the experience.

I would be happy to help prepare the first activity.

Alex
W16.explanation:
读懂：社团出席率低，负责人要的是不靠增加预算的实际建议。写信指出一种会议形式问题，提具体改法及其作用，再说明如何试行。
解析：范文把开头通知过长与成员难以参与联系起来，建议提前邮件发通知、开场做小组活动、结尾留提问时间，再用两次试行和调查检验。format 是“会议形式”，不能把任务改成申请更多经费或指责成员懒惰。
下次：用“现在哪里劝退成员→改变哪一步→为何更愿意来→试多久、怎样收反馈”组织。提出自己愿帮忙的工作，让建议可操作；不必照用范文活动，但要与出席问题有关。

W17.reference:
Dear Campus Services,

I noticed that the online campus map does not show the accessible entrance on the west side of the history building. The main entrance has several steps, so the omission could cause problems for visitors using wheelchairs or carrying heavy equipment.

Could you update the map to mark the west entrance and the paved route leading to it? It would also be helpful to indicate that this door is open during normal teaching hours.

I have attached a photograph of the entrance and can provide its exact location if needed. Adding this information would help students plan their routes independently and would make the map more useful for first-time visitors.

Thank you for considering the update.

Best regards,
Alex
W17.explanation:
读懂：校园地图漏标无障碍入口，可能让访客走到无法使用的路线。写给校园服务部门，说明遗漏和影响、建议地图更新，并让更新对访客实用。
解析：范文说明主门有台阶，建议标出另一侧入口、通向它的铺装路线和开放时间，并提供照片及位置协助。accessible entrance 是“便于有通行需求者使用的入口”，不只是最近的门。只加一个图标却不说明怎么到达，实用性仍不足。
下次：按“哪栋楼缺什么→谁会遇到障碍→地图补入口和路线→加开放信息或定位材料”写。方位和照片是范例细节，实际作答保持自洽，不把未核实的开放时间当官方事实。

W26.reference:
Dear Library Desk Team,

I reserved study room 204 for our group presentation practice this afternoon, but the projector does not turn on. We checked the power connection and followed the instructions beside the screen without success.

Our project includes several diagrams, so practicing without a display would make it difficult to check whether the audience can read them. Could you move our reservation to another room with a working projector? We can start up to thirty minutes later if that makes a replacement room available.

If no suitable room is free, borrowing a portable projector would also solve the problem. Please let me know which option is possible.

Thank you for your help.

Best regards,
Alex
W26.explanation:
读懂：小组已订图书馆自习室准备展示，但投影仪坏了。写信说明故障和预约用途、活动需要，并请求换房或提供可用设备。
解析：范文描述无法开机及已检查电源，再说明要一起查看图表是否清楚，提出换有投影仪的房间或借便携设备，并给出可稍晚开始的弹性。replacement 是“替代物”。只报故障却不说小组为何需要屏幕，工作人员难判断合适方案。
下次：按“预约哪场活动→设备怎样失灵→视觉材料的具体需要→首选与备用方案”写。给出可调整的条件，别默认图书馆一定有空房，也不要改成完全取消预约。

W27.reference:
Dear Volunteer Coordinator,

I am scheduled for the welcome-desk volunteer shift on Wednesday from two to four. Unfortunately, my biology department has arranged a required lab at the same time, and students cannot choose a different session.

Would it be possible to switch my shift to Friday afternoon? I am available from one until five and could cover either the welcome desk or the materials table. I have also asked another volunteer whether they would be willing to exchange shifts, but I wanted to check the procedure with you before confirming anything.

I understand that the desk needs continuous coverage, and I will help find a suitable arrangement. Thank you for considering my request.

Best regards,
Alex
W27.explanation:
读懂：必修实验课与已承诺的志愿班次冲突。给协调员说明受影响时段和原因，请求换班并给替代时间，还要减少排班受扰。
解析：范文明确周三原班次，提出周五可用时间及能承担的岗位，先询问换班流程而不擅自确认互换，照顾服务台持续有人值守的需要。shift 是“值班时段”，不只是一次活动。只说不能来、不安排补做，会遗漏继续履约的重点。
下次：依次写“原班次→无法避免的课程冲突→新时间和岗位→协助找人或交接”。把已询问别人和已获批准区分开，礼貌请协调员确认。

W28.reference:
Dear Professor Chen,

Thank you for sending me the article we discussed after class. Its comparison of two neighborhood surveys helped me understand why the wording of a question can influence the answers people give.

I plan to use the article when revising the questionnaire for my course project. In particular, I will replace two questions that assume respondents already use the campus shuttle. This should allow students with different travel habits to answer more accurately.

I will also include the article in my literature review and explain how its findings shaped my research design. If you have time during your next office hour, I would appreciate your feedback on the revised questions.

Best regards,
Alex
W28.explanation:
读懂：教授分享的文章帮助你理解课上讨论的想法。写信感谢、解释一个有用观点，再说明准备怎样用于自己的学习或项目。
解析：范文不是只说文章很好，而是指出问卷措辞影响回答，随后计划改掉默认所有人使用校车的题目，并在文献综述说明文章怎样影响设计，形成“观点→应用”的联系。apply an idea 是“运用一个想法”，不是只把文章放入参考文献。
下次：选文章中的一个可描述观点，再对照自己工作中一个可改变的步骤。按“感谢→我理解了什么→我将怎样改”写；额外请教可以有，但不能替代题目要求的具体应用。

W18.reference:
I support requiring one course outside a student's major, provided the university offers a meaningful range of choices. Student A is right that connections between fields can be valuable. An engineering student, for example, could use a course in public communication to explain a technical design to people without specialist knowledge.

Student B's concern about time is reasonable, so the outside course should replace an existing elective rather than increase the total graduation requirements. Advisors could help students select a course that complements their interests instead of treating it as an unrelated obligation. This approach would preserve time for advanced work in the major while encouraging students to consider how their expertise affects other people.
W18.explanation:
读懂：大学是否应要求学生修一门专业之外的课？已有发言分别强调跨学科联系与排课负担，你要提出并支持自己的看法，而非复述他们。
解析：范文赞成但附带选择空间，用工程生学公共沟通说明用途，再建议替换现有选修而非增加毕业负担，回应时间顾虑。outside their major 是“专业以外”。这只是可论证立场，反对强制也能写；仅说拓宽眼界而无机制会空泛。
下次：先选是否要求，再举某专业从另一学科获得何种能力，最后处理学分或排课限制。若反对，可说明更灵活的跨学科学习办法并解释为何更合适。

W19.reference:
If a city must choose between these investments, I would prioritize reliable public transportation. Student B identifies an immediate advantage: people need to reach jobs. Better transport also helps residents reach schools, medical appointments, and existing parks, so its benefits extend beyond commuting.

I agree with Student A that parks strengthen community life. However, a beautiful new park offers limited value to residents who cannot easily travel to it or who spend several hours each day commuting. The city could first improve service on routes connecting underserved neighborhoods, then use changes in travel patterns to identify locations for future parks. This would combine access and recreation over time instead of treating them as competing goals forever.
W19.explanation:
读懂：城市今年只能做一项大改善，应优先建公园还是改善公交？要权衡休闲健康与日常可达性，明确你的优先选择。
解析：范文优先公交，把就业进一步扩展到就医、上学和去已有公园，再提出先改善服务不足社区的路线，为未来公园选址提供依据，超出简单同意学生 B。prioritize 是“优先考虑”，不等于永远不要公园；公园优先也可有充分理由。
下次：先选投资方向，说明一类居民的具体收益，再解释在钱只够一项时为什么更急迫。最后回应另一项的一项价值，避免把对比写成“另一种完全没用”。

W20.reference:
Participation can contribute to course grades, but speaking frequently should not be the only way to earn credit. Student A makes a useful point about preparation: students are more likely to read carefully when they know their ideas will matter in class. Yet Student B is also right that quiet students may contribute thoughtful insights.

I would allow students to participate through short written reflections, small group discussion, or questions submitted before class. The teacher could assess whether each contribution refers to the material and develops a relevant idea. Such criteria would reward intellectual engagement instead of confidence or speed. A modest participation component would then encourage preparation without unfairly disadvantaging students who need more time to formulate their thoughts.
W20.explanation:
读懂：课堂讨论应不应该计入成绩？已有观点关注备课动力与安静学生的公平，你需说明什么参与方式值得评价。
解析：范文有条件支持，加入书面反思、小组讨论和课前问题，以内容相关性与思考深度代替发言次数，回应了公平顾虑。participation 指“参与”，不是仅指抢着说话。范文不是唯一立场，反对计分也应说明如何保证投入学习。
下次：按“是否计分→希望鼓励的行为→一个公平或不公平的情境→具体办法”写。比如解释为什么允许书面问题能体现准备，别只重复安静学生也有想法。

W21.reference:
Universities should expand small in-person seminars for courses that depend on interpreting evidence and defending arguments. Student B's emphasis on deeper conversations is persuasive because a teacher can ask immediate follow-up questions and help students examine assumptions they have not noticed.

Nevertheless, Student A is right that online courses offer valuable flexibility. Commuters and students with jobs may struggle to attend every session. One compromise is to provide short introductory lectures online while reserving classroom time for discussion in small groups. Students could review the background material at a convenient time, then arrive ready to apply it. This combination uses flexibility to support, rather than replace, the sustained exchange of ideas that makes seminars valuable.
W21.explanation:
读懂：学校下一年应增加网课还是小班面授研讨课？已有发言分别强调灵活安排和深入交流，你要说明资源为何优先用于某种学习方式。
解析：范文偏向需要讨论证据的面授课，用教师即时追问说明优势，又提出基础讲解线上看、见面时讨论的办法，回应通勤和工作的限制。seminars 是“小组研讨课”。支持更多网课也可成立，关键不是喊“线上方便”而是解释对哪些学生或任务有效。
下次：先选优先项和适用课程，再举一个学习过程，最后处理另一方式的优势。若提混合模式，要说各部分承担什么，别绕开增加哪类资源的问题。

W22.reference:
I would prefer a five-day class week with a lighter schedule each day. Student A is correct that a free weekday can help students arrange paid work. However, compressing the same classes into four days could create long sessions that leave little time to review material before the next lesson.

Student B's point about routine is especially relevant to demanding courses. A student learning a language or a mathematical method benefits from repeated opportunities to practice and ask questions. Universities could still support working students by offering several timetable options and avoiding unnecessary gaps between classes. That would improve flexibility without assuming that a compressed week suits every subject or every student's capacity to concentrate.
W22.explanation:
读懂：总授课时数不变，压缩成每周四天、每天更长，是否比五天分散上课好？不能把四天误解成少学一天的内容。
解析：范文选每天较轻的五天制，用语言或数学需要多次练习解释好处，再建议优化课表减少空档，回应学生工作的需要。free weekday 是空出一个工作日，并非课业总量减少。四天制也能论证，但需面对疲劳和复习间隔问题。
下次：按“偏好四天或五天→某类课程或学生的具体安排→对方方案的代价→怎样缓解”展开。用一天或一周的实际节奏支持观点，而非只说多休息很好。

W23.reference:
Campus dining halls should provide environmental labels, but the labels need a brief explanation of what they measure. Student A is right that information can influence choices. A student comparing two similar lunches might reasonably prefer the meal associated with lower emissions.

Student B's concern about oversimplification should shape the design. A single score should not imply that it captures every issue, such as water use, packaging, and labor conditions. Dining halls could show a broad emissions category and provide a link explaining the estimate and its uncertainty. They should also keep nutritious lower-impact meals affordable. Labels would then support informed decisions while acknowledging that information alone cannot remove the practical barriers students face.
W23.explanation:
读懂：食堂是否应标注餐食的环境影响？既要考虑帮助选择，也要面对估算口径不同、单个标记可能误导的问题。
解析：范文支持附解释的标签，主张显示大致排放类别并说明估算不确定性，再补充低影响餐食也需价格可负担。environmental impact 是“环境影响”，不能等同于所有健康或社会问题。范文是一个方案，反对简化标签也可提出理由。
下次：先明确是否标，再说标签具体测什么、学生怎样用它，最后给出防误解或价格方面的措施。别声称一个分数能精确代表用水、包装等全部影响，也别只重述两位同学。

W24.reference:
Living on campus can help first-year students develop a support network, but I would not make it compulsory. Student A identifies an important benefit: informal conversations and shared activities can make a new university feel less intimidating. However, Student B's concern about costs can be decisive for some families.

Instead of requiring campus housing, universities should make the benefits of residential life available to commuters as well. For example, small mentoring groups could meet at convenient times, and common rooms could provide places to relax between classes. Students who choose to live on campus would still gain frequent social contact, while those living at home would not have to accept additional housing costs simply to participate in university life.
W24.explanation:
读懂：新生应不应该住校？讨论要权衡建立支持网络和家庭成本，不是只描述宿舍生活。
解析：范文认为住校有益但不宜强制，用通勤生也能参加的导师小组和公共休息区，说明社交支持不必只靠付住宿费获得。compulsory 是“强制的”。支持住校或优先居家都可写，须说明适用条件，不能推定每位学生的家庭和预算相同。
下次：先区分“鼓励住校”与“必须住校”，再举一种新生处境，解释你的建议怎样同时处理融入与成本。加入可执行安排，让观点超出“交朋友好、住宿贵”的复述。

W25.reference:
Museums should offer free admission to local students at selected times rather than eliminate admission charges entirely. Student A is right that access can encourage learning, particularly when a student wants to return to an exhibition after studying its subject in class.

Student B's revenue concern is also legitimate. Museums must maintain collections and pay staff, and those costs do not disappear when visitors are admitted free. A designated student afternoon could increase access during a quieter period without replacing all paid visits. Partnerships with local schools or businesses could help fund the program. The museum should track attendance and educational use, then adjust the schedule so that the policy supports both learning and long-term financial stability.
W25.explanation:
读懂：博物馆是否应让本地学生免费入场？票价影响学习机会，但藏品维护、员工和展览仍需要资金。
解析：范文提出指定时段免费，用学生可反复参观说明教育价值，再用低峰时段、合作资助与跟踪使用情况应对收入顾虑。free admission 是“免门票”，不是运营零成本。全面免费或保留收费也能论证，不必照抄折中政策。
下次：先说谁在何时免费或为何收费，再举一种学习用途，接着解释资金或开放安排怎样维持。若提赞助，说明资助对象和作用，别假设取消门票自然不会影响服务。

W29.reference:
Universities should offer digital textbooks as an option, especially in subjects where information changes rapidly. Student A correctly notes that digital versions are easier to update. They can also reduce the need for students to buy a completely new edition when only a few chapters have changed.

However, Student B's preference for annotating printed books deserves consideration. Some students concentrate better on paper or have limited access to a reliable device. A flexible policy could provide digital access while keeping printed copies in the library and allowing students to purchase affordable print versions. Teachers should also choose formats that work offline. This would capture the advantages of current material without assuming that one reading format meets every student's needs.
W29.explanation:
读懂：大学是否应用电子版替代部分纸质教材？已有观点谈更新检索便利和纸上深度阅读，你应针对用途与限制提出看法。
解析：范文支持提供电子选项，尤其信息变化快的学科，同时保留图书馆纸本、可负担印本和离线使用，以照顾专注方式与设备条件。some 是“部分”，不是所有书都必须取消。选择保留更多纸本也可论证，不能只重复“电子易更新”。
下次：先说明替换范围，再选一种真实阅读任务比较格式，最后处理最明显限制。如重视电子更新，就解释没稳定设备的学生怎么办；把政策与学习需要连接起来。

W30.reference:
Campus buildings should remain open later during exam periods, but the university should concentrate this service in a few suitable locations. Student A is right that some students lack a quiet place to study at home. Reliable access to study space can therefore make a meaningful difference.

At the same time, Student B correctly identifies staffing and energy costs. Keeping every building open would be expensive and might spread security staff too thinly. A better policy would extend the hours of one library floor and a nearby study center, with clear information about transport and safety. The university could monitor how many students use these spaces and expand provision only when demand justifies the additional costs.
W30.explanation:
读懂：考试期间是否应延长校园建筑开放时间？要在安静学习空间与工作人员、照明等成本间作取舍。
解析：范文有条件支持，只集中开放部分图书馆和学习中心，配合交通安全信息并看实际使用量再扩展。这回应了在家缺少安静空间的学生，也避免把少数需求变成全校园高成本开放。stay open later 是“开得更晚”，并非全天通宵。
下次：先推荐开放或不开放，再说明目标学生、具体地点或时段以及成本处理。若反对延时，可提出满足晚间学习的替代办法；范文的集中开放只是一个可行思路，不是唯一答案。

accepted: Could you tell me where the registration office is?
W31.explanation:
读懂：你刚到校园，需要报名选课，因此礼貌地问：“能告诉我注册办公室在哪里吗？”
解析：外层 Could you tell me 是“能告诉我吗”，真正想知道的内容从 where 开始。里面按 the registration office is 排，即先说办公室，再说它在哪里，不能照直接问句排成 where is the registration office。does 是多余词块，不能与末尾 is 重复使用。
下次：把句子分为“礼貌开头”和“所问内容”。先放 could、you、tell me，再用 where 连接，借题面固定的办公室名称把 is 放到最后。

accepted: Where are the books that arrived yesterday?
W32.explanation:
读懂：昨天收到所需书籍后，你问：“昨天到的那些书在哪里？”不是问书什么时候到的。
解析：Where are the books 是主要问题；that arrived yesterday 紧跟 books，帮助别人辨认是哪一批书。books 是复数，所以题中用 are；arrived 说昨天已经到达。不要把 yesterday 接到 are 后，也不能把 that 放在 books 前，让补充说明脱离它说明的对象。
下次：先排“Where—are—书”，再把“昨天到的”整段接到书后面。检查 are 管“现在在哪里”，arrived 管“昨天到达”，两者并不冲突。

accepted: Although the experiment failed, the results raised an interesting question.
The results raised an interesting question although the experiment failed.
The experiment failed but the results raised an interesting question.
The results raised an interesting question but the experiment failed.
W33.explanation:
读懂：实验失败了，结果却引出一个有趣的问题，回答失败是否仍有收获。
解析：although 是“虽然”，可引出句首或句尾的让步部分；也可用 but（但是）把“实验失败”与“结果有收获”连接起来。两种方式都接受，但不能在这一句中同时用 although 和 but；只使用一个连接词，另一个词块不使用。
下次：先拼“实验失败”与“结果引出问题”两件事，再选一个转折连接词；最后检查 raised 的对象是 question，并核对没有多放连接词。

accepted: How long have you been collecting temperature records?
W34.explanation:
读懂：项目已用了几个季节的温度记录，你问对方一直收集这些记录有多久了。
解析：How long 是“多长时间”，have you been collecting 表示从之前开始、一直在做的收集工作。提问时把 have 放在 you 前，been collecting 是完整词块，不能拆开。did 是多余项，不能排成 did you been collecting；那样少了与 been 配合的 have。
下次：听到“持续到现在多久”先想 How long have you been…，再接 collecting 的对象 temperature records（温度记录），不要只因开始在过去就选 did。

accepted: Does the application have to be submitted before the office closes?
W35.explanation:
读懂：你问申请是否必须在办公室关门之前提交，关注的是提交要求和截止时点。
解析：Does 放在整句开头，后面 the application have to 表示“申请必须”；有 Does 后要用 have，不能再选 has。申请是被人提交，所以接 be submitted（被提交），不是让申请自己做动作。before the office closes 是“办公室关门前”，顺序保持完整。
下次：按“是否—申请—必须被提交—在什么之前”分组。认准 Does 与 have 配合，把干扰块 has 留下；最后检查 be 没有漏掉，否则“被提交”的结构不完整。

accepted: Would you mind explaining the final step again?
Would you mind again explaining the final step?
W36.explanation:
读懂：对方愿意解释你不懂的步骤，你礼貌地请他再说明最后一步。
解析：Would you mind… 是“您介意……吗”，本题用来委婉提出请求，后面接 explaining，不接解释动作的其他形式。the final step 是解释对象；again 是“再一次”。参考接受 again 放句尾，也接受放在 explaining 前，不能因此把后一种词序判作语法错误。
下次：先把 would you mind 与 explaining 连起来，再放要解释的步骤。用 again 补出“重复讲解”的意思，回看题意，避免漏掉最后一步或“再一次”。

accepted: Were the tutor and the students both available on Monday?
On Monday, were the tutor and the students both available?
W37.explanation:
读懂：上周安排见面时，你想确认导师和学生双方在周一是否都有空。
解析：Were 引出对过去情况的提问；the tutor and the students 要连成整体，再接 both available（双方都有空）。on Monday 表示询问的时间，可放句末，也可放整个问句前；无论在哪，Were 都要在主语前。
下次：先把两方连起来，排好“Were—双方—都有空”，再加周一这个时间；检查时间移动后，主语内部没有被拆开，问句词序也没变。

accepted: The more carefully we plan, the less time we waste.
W38.explanation:
读懂：我们计划得越仔细，浪费的时间就越少；两部分表达一起变化的关系。
解析：固定的 The…，the… 对应中文“越……，就越……”。more carefully 说明 we plan 怎么做，less time 是 we waste 的对象。不要因中文说“计划越仔细”就排成 we plan more carefully：题面要求比较部分先出现。也不能把 less time 放到 we plan 这一边。
下次：先配好“更仔细—我们计划”和“更少时间—我们浪费”两组，再依次放入两个 the 后。核对因果方向：仔细程度增加，浪费减少。

accepted: I would have joined the trip if I had seen the announcement.
If I had seen the announcement, I would have joined the trip.
W39.explanation:
读懂：当时没看到通知，所以没参加旅行；意思是“要是当时看到了，我本来就会参加”。
解析：if I had seen the announcement 设想过去未发生的条件；I would have joined the trip 说本可发生的结果。would have 是一整块，不要换成单独的 would，也不要把 had seen 当成真实发生的事。两个 I 各管一段，并非重复的干扰词。条件段在前或在后都被接受。
下次：先问“当时缺了什么条件”，再说“本来会怎样”。将 had seen 配通知、would have joined 配旅行，别漏掉任何一个 I。

accepted: Does the article explain why some coastal communities moved inland?
W40.explanation:
读懂：你问文章有没有解释一些沿海社区为什么迁往内陆，重点是迁移原因是否得到说明。
解析：固定 Does 后排 the article explain，外层问“文章解释了吗”。why 后面是文章要解释的内容，按 some coastal communities moved inland 排，即“社区—迁移了—到内陆”。不能在 why 后再加 did 去组成另一个独立问题；词库的 did 在这里不用。
下次：先搭“Does—文章—explain”，再接 why 和正常叙述顺序。把 coastal 理解为“沿海的”、inland 理解为“向内陆”，避免颠倒迁移方向。

accepted: Did all of the participants agree with the proposed changes?
W41.explanation:
读懂：委员会昨天提出了修改方案，你问所有与会者是否都赞同这些修改。
解析：Did 已告诉读者是在问过去的事，后面的动作要用 agree，不再用 agreed；agreed 是本题干扰块。all of the participants 是“所有与会者”，整块接在 Did 后。agree with 表示“赞同”，with 后必须接 the proposed changes（提出的修改），不能漏掉 with。
下次：先排“Did—所有与会者—agree”，再补“赞同什么”。遇见 Did 和过去式动作同时出现时，检查是否重复表示过去；也要保留 all 的“所有”范围。

accepted: Have you compared your findings with those of earlier studies?
W42.explanation:
读懂：对方收集完研究数据，你接着问：“你把自己的发现与以前研究的发现比较过了吗？”
解析：固定 Have 后接 you compared，表示到现在是否已经比较过。compare A with B 是“把甲和乙比较”，your findings 是甲，those of earlier studies 是乙，其中 those 代替前面提到的 findings，不是指研究人员。with 不能跑到自己的发现之前。
下次：先找两个被比较的对象，将 your findings 与 those of earlier studies 放在 with 两边，再接 Have you compared。别把“收集完成”误当成“比较也完成”。

accepted: Had the last train already left when you reached the station?
When you reached the station, had the last train already left?
W43.explanation:
读懂：你们到车站比计划晚，你问到站时末班车是否已经离开。
解析：Had the last train already left 询问过去某个时点之前是否已完成；when you reached the station 给出到站时点，可在整个问句前或后。when 内部按 you reached 排，主要问句仍以 Had 引出；did 是多余词，不能替换 Had 后还保留 already left。
下次：画出“车可能先离开—你后来到站”两点，再拼主要问句与 when 时间部分；最后检查时间部分用陈述顺序，Had 仍在 the last train 前。

accepted: Is this the first course you have taken outside your department?
W44.explanation:
读懂：你问对方正在上的课是否是他第一次选修本院系之外的课程。
解析：Is this 是外层“这是……吗”；the first course 是要确认的课程，you have taken 紧接其后，说明“你修过的”。outside your department 表示“本院系之外”，不能拆成 outside this 或把 you have taken 变成独立提问的顺序。题目只提供一个 Is，它负责整句发问。
下次：先拼“Is this the first course”，再接“你修过的—在院系之外”。注意 first 与 have taken 一起把当前这门课放到以往修课经历中比较。

accepted: What surprised the researchers about the recovery?
W45.explanation:
读懂：研究团队报告了意外结果，你问这次恢复过程有什么地方让研究人员感到意外。
解析：What 在这里就是造成惊讶的“什么事情”，直接接 surprised，再接感到惊讶的人 the researchers。不是所有含 what 的问句都要加 did；本题插入 did 会与 surprised 的形式冲突。about the recovery 限定谈论哪件事，recovery 仅指“恢复”，题面未说明是哪种恢复。
下次：先改想“某件事让研究人员吃惊”，把某件事换成 What，其他顺序保留。不要把研究人员误排成执行 surprised 动作的人。

accepted: Do you know whether we need to arrange access to the building?
W46.explanation:
读懂：访客想在非开放时间进楼，你问同伴是否知道我们需不需要安排入楼权限。
解析：Do you know 是外层提问；whether 表示“是否”，后面照平常说话排 we need to arrange access。access to the building 是“进入该楼的权限或通道安排”，to the building 不能放在 need 后。词库里额外的 do 不用于 whether 后，那里不是第二个直接问句。
下次：先说“你知道吗”，再接“是否—我们需要—安排进入权限”。把两个带 to 的词块按意义分清：一个引动作，一个说明进入哪里。

accepted: The equipment is too heavy for one person to carry safely.
The equipment is too heavy for one person to safely carry.
The equipment is too heavy for one person safely to carry.
For one person, the equipment is too heavy to carry safely.
For one person, the equipment is too heavy to safely carry.
W47.explanation:
读懂：设备太重，单靠一个人无法安全搬运；too heavy 表示重量超过了安全搬运的范围。
解析：the equipment is too heavy 是主线，for one person 说明一个人来搬，to carry 是搬运动作。safely（安全地）可放 carry 后、to 后，或 for one person 与 to 之间；for one person 也可放整句前。各接受词序都保留“一个人无法安全搬”的意思。
下次：先连好“设备—太重—搬运”，再加搬运者和安全限制；移动修饰语后读回整句，核对设备是被搬的物品，to 与 carry 仍构成动作。

accepted: Can you explain what led the team to revise its conclusion?
W48.explanation:
读懂：团队核对数字后修改了结论，你请对方解释是什么促成这次修改。
解析：Can you explain 是“你能解释吗”；what led the team 表示“什么使团队……”，what 自己充当原因，因此后面直接接 led，不加 did。lead someone to do 在这里是“促使某人做某事”，to revise 后接 its conclusion（团队的结论），不是修订数字本身。
下次：先排礼貌提问，再按“什么原因—促使团队—修改—结论”接上。别把题干中的核对数字直接当作唯一答案；本题要构造的是询问原因的句子。

accepted: Has the museum where she volunteers opened its new gallery yet?
W49.explanation:
读懂：你问朋友做志愿服务的那家博物馆，新展厅到现在开了没有。
解析：Has 与 opened 共同构成“已经开放了吗”；the museum 是谁开放展厅。where she volunteers 夹在中间，说明是哪家博物馆，整块应紧跟 museum。its new gallery 是开放对象，yet 在这里表示“到现在还／已经”，不能放进描述朋友做志愿服务的那一段。
下次：暂时拿开 where she volunteers，先拼“Has—博物馆—opened—新展厅—yet”，再把辨认博物馆的补充信息放回 museum 后面。

accepted: If the room had better lighting, we could display the photographs there.
We could display the photographs there if the room had better lighting.
W50.explanation:
读懂：如果这个房间照明更好，我们就能在那里展示照片；这是对目前条件改善后的设想。
解析：if the room had better lighting 不是讲已经改善，而是设想“要是照明更好”；could display 是相应的“就能展示”。will 是干扰块，不要加到已有的 could display 前。there 指这个房间，应跟展示地点相连。条件段在句首或句尾都在可接受答案中。
下次：先配“房间—更好的照明”，再配“我们—能展示—照片—在那里”，用 if 连接。别把 had better lighting 误拆成“最好去做”的另一种表达。

accepted: How do people adapt when they move to an unfamiliar environment?
W51.explanation:
读懂：人们搬到陌生环境时如何适应？问题同时问适应方法和发生适应的情境。
解析：How do people adapt 是主要问题，people 指多人，用 do 而不是干扰块 does。when they move to an unfamiliar environment 补充“搬到不熟悉的环境时”，这里 they move 保留正常叙述顺序。to 表示搬去哪里，不能把整块环境接到 people 后而丢掉 move。
下次：先排“如何—do—人们—适应”，再用 when 加“他们搬去陌生环境”。检查 do 只放在主要问题中，不在 when 后重复提问。

accepted: Do you remember how many copies of our proposals we should bring?
W52.explanation:
读懂：组织者要求带提案副本，你问同伴还记不记得我们应该带多少份。
解析：固定 Do 后接 you remember，外层问“你记得吗”。how many copies of our proposals 是“我们提案的多少份副本”，应连成一组；后面排 we should bring，不排 should we bring。额外的 do 是干扰，不能在这一段再加一次。
下次：分成“你记得吗—多少份提案副本—我们应该带”。先找到所问数量，再接谁该做什么，别把“多少份”误解为问有多少种提案。

accepted: Could you explain why the committee waited before making a decision?
W53.explanation:
读懂：你请对方解释，委员会为什么先等了一段时间才作决定，关注等待的原因。
解析：Could you explain 是礼貌请求；why the committee waited 是解释内容，里面先说委员会，再说等过。before making a decision 表示“作决定之前”，making 与 before 已在同一词块，不要拆开。did 不应加在 why 后，否则破坏这里的叙述顺序。
下次：先完成“能解释吗”，再接 why 和“委员会等了”，最后放“作决定前”。不要看到句末问号就把每一小段都倒过来问，外层已经负责提问。

accepted: Does the software make it easier to organize large collections of notes?
W54.explanation:
读懂：这款软件能否让大量笔记更容易整理？要确认的是工具对整理工作的帮助。
解析：Does 开头时后面用 make，不选 makes。make it easier to organize 是“让整理这件事更容易”，it 先占住位置，真正的事情由 to organize 引出。large collections of notes 是要整理的大量笔记，别把它放在软件的位置。
下次：按“Does—软件—make—更容易—整理—大量笔记”排序。把 it easier 当完整词块保留，不因中文通常不说“它”就遗漏 it；同时排除 makes。

accepted: Despite the additional cost, the department chose the more durable materials.
The department chose the more durable materials despite the additional cost.
W55.explanation:
读懂：尽管多花一些钱，院系还是选择了更耐用的材料，重点在成本与耐用性的取舍。
解析：despite the additional cost 是“尽管有额外成本”，整块已经表达让步，不能再把 although 塞进去。the department chose the more durable materials 是“院系选择了更耐用的材料”，chose 表示已经作出的选择。参考接受成本这一段在前或在后。
下次：先拼“院系—选了—更耐用材料”，再加整块成本限制。记住 despite 后这里直接跟“成本”这件事，不要仅凭两词都能译为“虽然”就叠用 although。

accepted: How long have you been waiting for a response from the office?
W56.explanation:
读懂：办公室还没回信，你问对方等待办公室回复已经持续多久了。
解析：How long 后接 have you been waiting，表示等待从之前延续到现在。wait for 是“等待”，所以 for a response 不能丢；from the office 说明回复来自办公室，不是说你从办公室开始移动。把 have 放 you 前，been waiting 紧跟 you。
下次：先记“多久—have you been waiting”，再加“等什么—来自谁”。读回去确认 for 管等待对象、from 管回复来源，两个小词功能不同，不能随意交换。

accepted: What did the survey reveal about what commuters needed most?
W57.explanation:
读懂：这项调查对于通勤者最需要什么，揭示了哪些信息？外面问调查发现，里面谈通勤者需求。
解析：What did the survey reveal 是外层问题，did 已表示过去，reveal 不再变过去式。about 后接 what commuters needed most，即“通勤者最需要的东西”，里面 commuters 在 needed 前。词块 did the survey 与 what commuters 已固定，不能把两组 what 当成重复项删掉。
下次：先拼“调查揭示了什么”，再补“关于通勤者最需要什么”。保留 most 的“最”，不要弱化成任何一般需求。

accepted: There is no reason to assume that every result will be identical.
W58.explanation:
读懂：没有理由假定每一次结果都会完全相同；这并不等于断言所有结果必然不同。
解析：固定 There is 后放 no reason，否定的是“有理由”。to assume 是“去假定”，that 后接具体假设 every result will be identical。no 不能挪到 every result 前，否则否定范围变了。identical 已在题面固定句尾，前面需要 will be 来接上“将会相同”。
下次：先搭“没有理由—去假定”，再完整放入“每个结果都会相同”这一想法。判断否定到底否定理由还是结果，别把“不保证一样”误读成“一定不一样”。

accepted: Is the footpath shorter than the road through town?
Is the road through town shorter than the footpath?
Is the footpath through town shorter than the road?
Is the road shorter than the footpath through town?
W59.explanation:
读懂：听说有步道通向车站，可以追问它与公路的长度；前一句没有说明哪条路更短，也没指定哪条穿过镇子。
解析：用 Is 把“一条路线＋shorter than＋另一条路线”变成比较问句；does 是多余词。through town 是“穿过镇子”，应紧跟它描述的路线。本题接受步道与公路交换比较位置，也接受该短语描述其中任一条路线，不能凭参考答案添加题面没有的限制。
下次：先明确要问哪条路是否更短，再排 Is、两条路线和 shorter than；将 through town 紧贴所描述的名词，最后检查比较关系完整、没有多用 does。

accepted: Can we begin the analysis before all the samples have arrived?
Before all the samples have arrived, can we begin the analysis?
W60.explanation:
读懂：还有样本没到，你问是否可以在全部到齐前开始分析，并非说样本已经全到。
解析：Can we begin the analysis 是主要请求；before all the samples have arrived 表示“所有样本到齐之前”，可放整个问句前或后。have arrived 描述到齐这个完成状态，但 before 指明分析可以更早开始；all 不能漏。
下次：先排“Can—我们—开始分析”，再拼完整的 before 时间部分；无论把时间放前还是放后，都检查是先开始、后到齐，别把 before 读成 after。

accepted: She suggested that we discuss the budget before choosing a venue.
She suggested that before choosing a venue we discuss the budget.
W61.explanation:
读懂：她建议我们先讨论预算，再选活动场地，回答建议讨论什么以及行动先后。
解析：固定 She 后接 suggested，that 引出建议内容 we discuss the budget，discuss 用原形，多余词块 to 不使用。before choosing a venue 是“选择场地之前”，可在预算之后，也可紧接 that 放在 we 前；两种词序都说明先讨论预算。
下次：先拼“她建议—我们讨论—预算”，再加入选场地前这个时间条件；检查固定 She、that 后的人与动作都保留，且没有排成 we to discuss。

accepted: The question is not whether to cooperate but how to share the work.
W62.explanation:
读懂：大家已同意合作，悬而未决的不是“要不要合作”，而是“如何分工”。
解析：固定 The question is 后用 not… but… 对照两个问题。whether to cooperate 是“是否合作”，how to share the work 是“怎样分担工作”。not 要放 whether 前，but 要接 how；如果把 not 放到 share 前，就会误写成不愿分工。两个带 to 的词块分别跟各自的问题词。
下次：先用中文圈出已解决的“是否”和未解决的“如何”，再排 not whether… but how…。别把合作本身说成争议，这与题意相反。

accepted: Anyone who wishes to attend should register by Thursday.
By Thursday, anyone who wishes to attend should register.
W63.explanation:
读懂：任何想参加的人都应最迟在周四报名，而不是等周四过后再报。
解析：anyone who wishes to attend 是“任何希望参加的人”，who wishes 说明是哪类人，后接 to attend。should register 才是他们应该做的事；词库另一个 to 不用，不能拼成 should to register。by Thursday 表示周四截止，放句首或句尾均有可接受答案。
下次：先拼“谁想参加”，再加“应该报名”，最后检查期限。把已有 to attend 与多余的 to 区分开，不要为了用完所有词块重复添加。

accepted: The report would be clearer if it included a diagram.
If it included a diagram, the report would be clearer.
If the report included a diagram, it would be clearer.
It would be clearer if the report included a diagram.
W64.explanation:
读懂：报告如果加入示意图，就会更清楚；这是改进建议，不是说已经加了图。
解析：would be clearer 是设想的效果，if 后的 included a diagram 是条件。the report 和 it 指同一份报告，可分别放在条件与结果中，if 部分也可在句首或句尾。included 用于假设，不说明过去真的做过；would be 是完整词块。
下次：先分出“加图”条件和“更清楚”结果，再安排 if 部分的位置；把 it 换回“报告”检查指代，确认图仍是条件、清晰仍是结果。

accepted: Have you checked whether every device has been switched off?
W65.explanation:
读懂：作为今晚最后离开实验室的人，你问对方是否已检查每台设备都关掉了。
解析：固定 Have 接 you checked，问“检查过了吗”；whether 后按 every device has been switched off 排。every device 逐个说每台设备，配 has，不用干扰块 have。has been switched off 是“已经被关掉”，不是设备自己执行关机动作；别漏掉 been。
下次：分清两层：外层“人检查了吗”，内层“设备是否被关闭”。把外层 Have 与内层 has 分开核对，别因设备有很多台就改成 every device have。

accepted: It was the unexpected delay that forced us to change our route.
W66.explanation:
读懂：是那次意外延误迫使我们改了路线；题目要求用 It 开头并强调真正原因。
解析：固定 It was 后先放要强调的 the unexpected delay，再用 that 接结果 forced us to change our route。forced us 是“迫使我们”，to change 后接路线；不能把 that 放到延误前，也不能让 our route 变成被迫做事的人。这种表达突出原因，不是把 It 翻成某件具体物品。
下次：找出“究竟是什么导致改变”，把它放在 It was 与 that 中间，再接“迫使谁做什么”。核对 unexpected 的意外性仍在，没改成原定的延误。

accepted: The lecturer emphasized the importance of checking sources independently.
The lecturer emphasized the importance of independently checking sources.
W67.explanation:
读懂：讲课者强调独立核查资料来源的重要性，不是只要求多收集来源。
解析：the importance of 是“……的重要性”，of 后用 checking sources 表示“核查来源”这件事，不加入干扰块 to。independently 是“独立地”，说明核查方式；参考接受它放 checking 前，也接受放 sources 后，不能断言只有句尾才对。
下次：先排“讲课者—强调了—重要性”，再接“核查来源—独立地”。注意来源是 checking 的对象，不要排成来源自己核查；确认没有把独立核查的方式省略。

accepted: Which of the ideas discussed at the meeting came from first-year students?
At the meeting, which of the ideas discussed came from first-year students?
Which of the ideas discussed came from first-year students at the meeting?
W68.explanation:
读懂：前一句说一年级学生在会上提出了有用想法；这题追问讨论过的想法中，哪些来自他们。
解析：Which of the ideas 是提问的主语，discussed 表示这些想法被讨论过，came from first-year students 说明来源。at the meeting 可紧接 discussed，也可在句首或句尾交代会上这个场景，都与前句一致。这里直接用“哪些想法”作 came 的主语，多余词块 did 不使用。
下次：先搭“哪些想法—来自一年级学生”，再加 discussed 限定所问想法，最后安放会议场景；核对主要动作仍是 came，别在它前面另加 did。

accepted: Could the materials be delivered before the workshop begins?
W69.explanation:
读懂：研讨会周五一早开始，你问材料能否在活动开始前送达。
解析：Could 放句首表示礼貌询问可能性，the materials 后接 be delivered（被送达），因为材料是被人送来的。are 是多余块，不能写成 could materials are delivered。before the workshop begins 表示“活动开始前”，begins 已固定在句尾，不需要另外加未来词。
下次：先排“Could—材料—被送达”，再接“在—活动—开始之前”。把 be delivered 当整体记住，检查 before 后的主角是 workshop，不要误写成材料开始。

accepted: Rather than repeat the whole experiment, we tested the uncertain measurement again.
We tested the uncertain measurement again rather than repeat the whole experiment.
Rather than repeat the whole experiment, we again tested the uncertain measurement.
We again tested the uncertain measurement rather than repeat the whole experiment.
W70.explanation:
读懂：我们没有重做整个实验，而是只把不确定的那项测量重新测了一次，强调缩小复查范围。
解析：rather than repeat the whole experiment 是“而不是重复整个实验”，整块不可拆。we tested the uncertain measurement 才是实际做的事；again 指重测，可放对象后，参考也接受放 tested 前。对照短语可以在句首或句尾，但不能把它误读成两件事都做了。
下次：先分清“没有做的广泛工作”和“实际做的针对性复查”，再把 tested 与 uncertain measurement 连好，最后加 again，保留只重测有疑问数据的重点。

W71.reference:
Dear Room Coordinator,
Our group reserved Room 16 for a presentation rehearsal on Thursday afternoon, but the screen did not turn on when we checked it today. We need to display several detailed graphs so that everyone can practice explaining the same evidence. Could you move our reservation to a room with a working display? A space for six students would be sufficient, and we could begin an hour later if necessary. If no room is available, borrowing a portable projector would also help. Please let me know which option is possible before Thursday morning so I can inform the group. Thank you for your assistance.
Best regards,
Alex
W71.explanation:
读懂：小组排练展示时发现预订房间的屏幕坏了。写给房间协调员，明确预约与故障、所需设备或房间条件，再提出可行替代方案。
解析：范文说明详细图表需供全组观看，提出六人空间、可晚一小时及借便携投影仪的备选，并给出通知小组所需的回复时间。rehearsal 是“正式展示前的排练”。只要求随便换房会忽略屏幕和容量，不一定解决实际问题。
下次：用“哪次预约→坏在哪里→人数与显示要求→换房或设备替代→何时需确认”写。区别必须满足的条件与可调整的时间，别让对方只能猜测什么房间适用。

W72.reference:
Dear Librarian,
I am registered for the research-database training on Tuesday at two, but my department has just scheduled a required laboratory class at the same time. I would still like to complete the training because I need to find reliable sources for my first research paper. Is there another session later this week? I am available after three on Wednesday and throughout Friday morning. If those sessions are full, I would be grateful for a place on the waiting list or access to equivalent recorded instruction. I apologize for changing my booking at short notice and appreciate your help finding a practical alternative.
Best regards,
Alex
W72.explanation:
读懂：图书馆培训与必修课撞时间，但你仍需培训来做课程项目。写信解释冲突、请求其他完成方式，并给出可参加的时段。
解析：范文说明研究数据库培训的重要性，列周三下午及周五上午的空档，再询问其他场次、候补或同等录播教学。availability 是“有空的时间”。只取消原报名或笼统说另找时间，会漏掉继续完成培训和可安排时段。
下次：按“原培训与必修课冲突→为什么仍要学→首选替代方式→两个具体空档”组织。备用录播可作为请求，不要假定图书馆已有；时间也不必照搬范文。

W73.reference:
Dear Service Manager,
I am writing about the opening hours listed for the equipment desk on the campus website. The page says that the desk stays open until six on Fridays, but the sign at the desk states that it closes at four. I arrived at five yesterday and could not collect a recorder needed for weekend fieldwork. Could you confirm the current hours and update the webpage if the sign is correct? Adding the change to existing reservation messages would also help students who booked earlier. I understand schedules sometimes change, but consistent information would prevent unnecessary journeys and missed collections. Thank you for checking this.
Best regards,
Alex
W73.explanation:
读懂：服务网页与柜台开放时间不一致，你据网页跑了一趟却没办成重要事项。写给经理指出冲突、说明影响，并要求确认正确时间及更新信息。
解析：范文对照网页六点、门口四点，再讲五点到达取不到录音机影响周末工作，且用“若门口信息正确”请求改网页，避免未经核实就断言哪方错。discrepancy 是“信息不一致”，不是服务人员故意误导。
下次：逐项写两个来源各说什么、自己何时到和哪件事受影响、请对方确认并同步网页或预约通知。别只要求延长营业时间，这不等同于解决信息冲突。

W74.reference:
Dear Dr. Chen,
Thank you for your lecture on urban wetlands yesterday. I was particularly interested in your explanation that a restored site's water movement matters as much as its visible vegetation. My class project compares two neighborhood parks, and I would like to understand how their ponds might influence storm runoff. Could you recommend an introductory article or book chapter that explains how researchers evaluate these systems? I have studied basic ecology but have little background in engineering, so a source that defines the main technical terms would be especially helpful. Your example gave me a clearer direction for the project, and I appreciate any reading advice you can offer.
Best regards,
Alex
W74.explanation:
读懂：客座讲座中的一个观点与你的项目有关，你想继续阅读但不是该领域专家。写信提具体观点、联系个人项目，并请求符合自己基础的读物。
解析：范文选城市湿地水流与植被同样重要的观点，联系公园池塘与雨水径流研究，再交代懂基础生态、缺工程知识，求解释术语的入门材料。introductory 是“入门的”。只请推荐好书却不说兴趣和程度，会让对方难选。
下次：按“我注意到的讲座观点→项目中想弄明白的问题→已学基础与知识缺口→希望的阅读形式”写。无需照搬湿地课题，但材料难度要与自述基础一致。

W75.reference:
Hi everyone,
Our science club is organizing a hands-on activity afternoon for local school students next Saturday, and we need four more volunteers. The event runs from one to four in the community hall. Volunteers will help small groups follow experiment instructions, keep materials organized, and guide visitors between tables. You do not need advanced science knowledge because we will provide a short training session before the doors open. If you can help, please reply by Wednesday and say whether you can stay for the full afternoon or only part of it. This will let us assign duties fairly and make sure every table has support. Thank you for considering it.
Best,
Alex
W75.explanation:
读懂：社团活动缺志愿者，要向同学说明活动和需帮忙时间、工作职责与准备培训，以及怎样报名和提供什么信息。
解析：范文介绍面向学校学生的科学活动，列指导实验、整理材料和引导访客的职责，说明提供简短培训，再请周三前回复可服务全程或部分时段。sign up 是“报名”。只说欢迎帮忙而不说要做什么、待多久，无法让同学决定。
下次：先交代活动对象与时间，再列两项具体工作和是否需经验，最后写报名渠道、期限及可用时段等所需信息。语气友好清楚，不把同学的帮助写成强制任务。

W76.reference:
Dear Bookstore Team,
I received my copy of Introduction to Environmental Studies yesterday, but pages 81 through 96 are missing. The binding appears intact, so this seems to be a printing problem rather than damage during delivery. I ordered the book online on Monday under order number 4182, and I have attached photographs of the gap and my receipt. Could you arrange a replacement copy? Our class will use the missing chapter next week, so collecting a checked copy from the campus shop would be faster than another delivery. Please also let me know how to return the incomplete book without an additional charge. Thank you for resolving this.
Best regards,
Alex
W76.explanation:
读懂：新买教材缺页，课程很快要用。写给书店说明缺哪些页与购买信息、为什么须及时处理，并提出换书或其他合适补救。
解析：范文提供缺页范围、订单号和收据照片，说明下周要读该章，提议到校内店取检查过的替换本，并问退回残书的办法。replacement copy 是“替换的一本”。只说书不好或要求道歉，不足以定位订单及解决上课需要。
下次：按“书名与订单→具体缺页→使用期限→希望的处理及交接”写。原因可说疑似印刷问题，不要把尚未核实的判断写成确定责任；示例页码和订单号不必照抄。

W77.reference:
Dear Professor Lee,
I am a second-year biology student considering a project on plant responses to dry conditions. Your laboratory's work on roots and soil communities seems closely related to my interests. Would it be possible to observe a routine lab session before I choose my project topic? I would like to understand the methods students use and the preparation a beginner would need. I am free on Tuesday morning or Thursday after two, but I can adjust to a time that is less disruptive for your team. I would follow all safety instructions and understand that some activities may not be open to visitors. Thank you for considering my request.
Best regards,
Alex
W77.explanation:
读懂：选研究项目之前，想去相关实验室短暂旁观。给负责人说明兴趣与该实验室的关系、希望了解什么、可用时间，并尊重研究和安全限制。
解析：范文把植物缺水反应与实验室根系研究联系起来，询问观察日常方法和初学者准备，提供两个空档，承诺遵守安全规定并接受部分活动不开放。observe 是“旁观”，不等于获准直接操作实验设备。
下次：先说明为何选这间实验室，再问一次范围明确的参访，最后给可协调时间及对限制的理解。别只写“我很喜欢科学”，也不要要求团队停下工作专门展示。

W78.reference:
Dear Housing Manager,
I have noticed that the lights in our residence building's glass entrance lobby remain at full brightness throughout sunny afternoons. The space already receives substantial daylight, so this may be using more electricity than necessary. Could the building team check whether the lighting schedule or daylight sensor can be adjusted? I am not suggesting switching off the lights in the stairwells, where steady illumination is important for safety. A trial in the entrance lobby would allow staff to see whether lower daytime brightness still provides comfortable visibility. I would be happy to help collect residents' feedback during the trial. Thank you for considering a small improvement to the building.
Best regards,
Alex
W78.explanation:
读懂：宿舍白天采光充足，灯仍全亮。给管理员描述具体位置与观察，提节能调整或试行方案，并说明如何维持安全通行。
解析：范文限定玻璃门厅，建议检查定时或日光传感设置，强调不关楼梯间照明，再试调门厅亮度、收住户反馈。trial 是“试行”，不是直接保证节电且完全无风险。只要求全楼关灯会违背安全条件。
下次：按“哪个区域何时亮度过高→让工作人员检查什么→小范围怎么试→哪些安全照明保留”写。用可观察现象支持建议，不编造省电百分比；留出工作人员评估能见度的空间。

W79.reference:
Hi everyone,
I am sorry that I cannot attend our study-group meeting tomorrow evening because my required lab session has been extended. I have finished summarizing the chapter on sampling methods and attached my notes, including two practice questions for us to discuss. Please use them during the meeting and add comments where my explanation needs clarification. Could someone send me the group's answers and any decisions about next week's revision plan afterward? I can also join a brief online call on Friday to review points I missed. I do not want my absence to slow the group down, so please continue with the original meeting time. Thanks for your understanding.
Best,
Alex
W79.explanation:
读懂：无法参加已约好的学习小组会议，但你已完成部分任务。写信交代缺席原因、分享自己的成果，并安排补上信息与后续工作。
解析：范文因必修实验延长请假，发送抽样方法笔记和练习题，请同伴批注、发来答案与计划，并提周五短通话补缺。contribution 是“你已做出的那部分工作”。只请人转述会议却不交出完成内容，会让小组仍无法使用你的贡献。
下次：写“为什么缺席→已完成什么、怎样取得→请反馈哪些决定→我何时补做”。不必要求全组为你改期；可明确愿修改笔记或承担后续任务，减少缺席影响。

W80.reference:
Dear Orientation Coordinator,
I would like to suggest adding a short practical campus tour to next year's orientation. The presentations this year explained many services, but several new students, including me, still struggled to find places such as the media desk and accessibility office. Small groups led by current students could visit four essential locations immediately after the main presentation. Each stop would include one example of when a student might use the service. This could fit into thirty minutes and use volunteer guides already helping with orientation. A simple route map would let late arrivals follow the same tour independently. I think this change would turn useful information into something students can act on.
Best regards,
Alex
W80.explanation:
读懂：院系征集迎新改进意见。用自己的经历提出一个具体变化，说明它解决新生什么困难，并给出利用现有资源的实施或试验办法。
解析：范文发现听完介绍仍找不到服务地点，于是建议学长带小组实地走四个地点、每站讲使用场景，借现有志愿者和路线图在半小时内完成。orientation 是“新生入门介绍”，不只是迎新表演。只说多办活动不够具体。
下次：按“新生卡住的一件事→针对性的变化→谁来做、何时做、用什么现有资源”组织。若采用导览之外的建议，也要把操作和问题对上，不申请题目没有要求的大预算。

W81.reference:
Dear Museum Education Team,
I am preparing a class presentation about how everyday objects reveal local history, and I would like to photograph three household items in your permanent gallery. The images would appear only in a presentation for my seminar and would not be posted publicly or used commercially. Could you confirm whether this use is permitted and whether particular objects have additional restrictions? I would take photographs without flash and avoid including other visitors. If original photography is not allowed, I would be grateful for approved images or a link to your educational collection. I will credit the museum and include any required object information. Thank you for your guidance.
Best regards,
Alex
W81.explanation:
读懂：课程项目想拍博物馆物件，但拍摄及在作业中使用图片是否获准都未知。写信说明项目与对象、照片用途，并询问许可和限制。
解析：范文说明家庭用品与地方历史的关系，限定只在课堂展示、不公开商用，再问具体展品限制，提出无闪光、不拍其他访客及获准图片的备选。permission 是“许可”，自称非商业用途不等于自动有权拍摄。
下次：先写拍什么、为何拍，再说明在哪展示、是否公开，最后请确认规则与可替代图片来源。署名和遵守限制可表达意愿，但不能替馆方批准自己的计划。

W82.reference:
Dear Volunteer Coordinator,
During yesterday's afternoon shift, only two volunteers were available to organize donations and help visitors at the same time. We managed the essential work, but several people waited much longer than usual. Could we invite volunteers from the morning team to cover a one-hour overlap next week? That would help during the busiest period without requiring everyone to take a full extra shift. I can prepare a short checklist of the tasks that need immediate attention and help train anyone who is unfamiliar with the afternoon routine. Please let me know whether the overlap is possible or whether another arrangement would work better. Thank you for coordinating our efforts.
Best regards,
Alex
W82.explanation:
读懂：志愿班次人手不足，可能影响效率和安全。写给协调员说明困难及后果，提一个现实临时办法，并说你能具体帮什么。
解析：范文用两人兼顾整理捐赠和接待导致排队的情况说明压力，建议忙时让早班重叠一小时，自己准备优先任务清单和培训新人。overlap 指“两班部分时间重合”。只批评排班或要求所有人加一整班，不如针对高峰期安排具体。
下次：按“少了哪类人手→哪些任务受影响→短时如何补位→我负责清单、交接或培训什么”写。让协调员确认方案，别擅自宣布其他志愿者必须加班。

W83.reference:
Hi everyone,
I found a blue notebook under a seat near the window in Room 23 after our history seminar this morning. It has an elastic strap and a small white sticker on the front. I have not read the notes inside, but it seems likely to belong to someone in our class. If it is yours, please reply with a brief description of the sticker so I can make sure it reaches the right person. I will leave it with the department reception desk tomorrow afternoon if nobody contacts me before then. You can also collect it from me after Wednesday's seminar. I hope this helps reunite the owner with their work.
Best,
Alex
W83.explanation:
读懂：你在研讨室捡到笔记本，要通过班级邮件寻找失主，又要保护内容隐私并防止冒领。需给识别特征、验证办法和安全归还安排。
解析：范文公开颜色、带子和找到的位置，却只说有贴纸，不公开贴纸细节，让认领者私下描述；再给本人交还或系办公室代存的办法。confirm 指“确认归属”。若把内部笔记和全部细节广播出去，就失去验证依据。
下次：先写不敏感的外观与发现地点，保留一个只有主人容易知道的特征私下核实，再写何时何地取回及无人认领时怎么保管。别要求对方公开私人笔记。

W84.reference:
Dear Professor Rivera,
I am writing about next week's river observation activity. The route description includes a long flight of uneven steps, which I cannot safely use. I would still like to complete the same learning objectives and contribute observations to my group. Is there an accessible section of the river where I could record flow conditions and land use? If necessary, I could work with published photographs for the part of the route I cannot reach and compare them with my partners' notes. Please let me know which arrangement would meet the assignment requirements. I am available to discuss the practical details before class. Thank you for helping me participate fully.
Best regards,
Alex
W84.explanation:
读懂：野外课程路线或流程有你无法安全使用的部分。给教师说明相关障碍、请求替代安排，并解释如何仍达到学习目标，不是申请免学。
解析：范文只交代不平整长阶梯的通行困难，提出在可达河段观察流况与土地使用，并用照片和同伴记录补看不能到的部分，再请教师确认符合要求。learning objectives 是“学习目标”；无需透露无关个人病史。
下次：按“哪段活动有障碍→具体替代地点或材料→仍能观察和比较什么→请教师确认”写。替代办法必须联系原任务，不能只要求换成不相关的轻松作业。

W85.reference:
Dear Dr. Morgan,
Our student research society is holding a panel on how local questions can become useful research projects, and we would be delighted if you could participate. The audience will mainly be undergraduates beginning their first independent studies. We hope you could give a ten-minute account of your neighborhood transport project and then join a twenty-minute discussion with two student presenters. The event is planned for October 18 at four in the afternoon, with an online connection available if travel is inconvenient. Please let us know whether you would be interested and if the proposed time works for you. We can send a more detailed program before you decide.
Best regards,
Alex
W85.explanation:
读懂：你想邀本地研究者参加学生座谈。信中须交代主题与听众、希望对方做什么及花多久，并邀请回复、提供更多信息。
解析：范文把听众定为初做独立研究的本科生，邀请研究者用十分钟讲社区交通项目，再参加二十分钟讨论，还交代时间与线上参加可能。panel 是“多人座谈”，不等于请对方独讲整场。只写欢迎莅临不足以让研究者判断投入。
下次：用“主题为何相关→学生需要听什么→具体发言和讨论时长→活动时间及回复请求”组织。范文日期只是安排示例；询问是否合适而不是宣称对方已经答应。

W86.reference:
Hi everyone,
I accidentally replaced the methods section and the opening paragraph of the results while uploading my revised section this afternoon. I am sorry for the confusion. I have already checked the version history and restored the most recent complete draft, but please review your own section to confirm that no final changes are missing. My new text is now in a separate file so we can compare it carefully before merging. To prevent this happening again, I suggest editing our assigned sections in the shared document instead of uploading whole replacement files. We could also save a dated backup before major revisions. Please tell me if anything still needs recovering, and I will help fix it.
Best,
Alex
W86.explanation:
读懂：你误覆盖了小组共享文档，已开始查找旧版本。要及时说明经过和受影响内容、汇报或提出恢复步骤，再建议防止重演。
解析：范文先点明方法部分和结果开头被覆盖，再认错并说明已恢复最近完整稿，但仍请组员核对最后修改，把新文字单独存放后再合并，并建议只改负责段落、重大修订前做备份。version history 是“历史版本”。只道歉不交代恢复状态，或未核对就保证没损失，都不利于协作。
下次：依次写“我何时误改哪部分→已做与尚待检查的步骤→需要队友核对什么→今后怎样编辑和备份”。把恢复事实与计划分清，别把责任推给软件。

W87.reference:
Dear Club Leader,
Several commuter members have mentioned that our eight o'clock evening meetings finish after the last convenient train. I enjoy participating, but leaving early means missing decisions and volunteer assignments. Could we try meeting at six on alternate weeks? This would let commuters stay for the full discussion while preserving some later meetings for members with afternoon classes. We could also circulate the agenda beforehand and keep routine announcements in a written update, making the meeting shorter. A brief survey after a month would show whether the trial improves attendance without creating new difficulties. Thank you for considering a schedule that includes more of the club's members.
Best regards,
Alex
W87.explanation:
读懂：通勤社员难以参加现有会议时间，但其他人也有课。给负责人说明通勤困难、提出具体改时方案，并回应其他成员的顾虑。
解析：范文说明晚间会议结束后赶不上方便乘坐的火车，提议隔周提前到六点、保留部分晚场，兼顾下午有课者，并用提前发议程和试行调查检查效果。alternate weeks 是“隔周”，不是所有会议都改。只按自己方便定时间，违背公平考虑。
下次：按“通勤者具体错过什么→哪几次改到何时→谁可能受影响→如何兼顾并检查”写。不要重复一般的出席率建议而漏掉返程列车安排这一具体原因。

W88.reference:
Dear Applications Office,
I submitted my application for the summer field course yesterday and noticed that I entered an incorrect availability date. The application is under the name Alex Chen, with reference FC318. I listed June 12 as my earliest start date, but I am actually available from June 19 because my examinations finish the previous day. All other information remains correct. Could you update the date, or should I complete a correction form through the portal? I understand that availability affects group allocation and wanted to notify you before placements are assigned. Please let me know if you need any supporting information. Thank you for your help correcting the record.
Best regards,
Alex
W88.explanation:
读懂：已提交的申请有一处信息错误，你不想重复提交造成混乱。写信标明申请与错项、提供正确信息，并问如何办理更正。
解析：范文用姓名与申请编号定位，将原填的最早开始日期与正确日期直接对照，说明其余信息不变，再问办公室可代改还是要走更正表。correction 是“更正”，不是重新申请。只说日期错了却不列正确值，工作人员无法处理。
下次：按“哪份申请→原内容→应改成什么→请确认更新步骤”写。可简述为何及时更正影响分组，但别替办公室决定流程，也不要另投第二份造成重复记录。

W89.reference:
Dear Community Center Team,
Thank you for allowing our class to interview volunteers about the neighborhood reading program. Your explanations helped us understand why flexible meeting times matter for families, something we had overlooked when designing our initial survey. We used that insight to revise our questions and received much clearer responses. Our final report recommends preserving the evening sessions while providing a simple reminder system for participants. We would be pleased to send you a copy if it would be useful for future planning. The report contains no names or identifying quotations from the interviews. We appreciate the time you gave us and the opportunity to learn from your practical experience.
Best regards,
Alex
W89.explanation:
读懂：本地机构曾支持课程项目，项目已完成。写信感谢并说明帮助怎样被使用、分享具体成果，再询问是否需要报告或其他跟进，别直接塞大附件。
解析：范文说明志愿者访谈让小组意识到家庭需要灵活时间，因而改进问卷，最终建议保留晚间阅读活动并加提醒系统，再主动提供去除身份信息的报告。outcome 是“具体成果”，不能只说我们完成了项目。
下次：用“你们提供了什么→我们据此改了什么→产出一个结论或建议→是否愿收报告”串起来。把感谢与实际用途相连，确认对方意愿后再分享，不披露参与者私人信息。

W90.reference:
Dear Delivery Team,
A package was left at my apartment this morning, but the label is addressed to Apartment 42 in the neighboring building. I live in Apartment 24, and I have kept the package unopened. The tracking number on the label is 762184. Could you arrange to collect it and deliver it to the correct address? I will be home tomorrow between nine and noon, or I can leave it with our staffed reception desk if that is easier for the driver. Please confirm the collection arrangement before I hand it over. I would like the intended recipient to receive it promptly without risking another mistaken delivery. Thank you for your assistance.
Best regards,
Alex
W90.explanation:
读懂：送到你家的包裹实际属于另一公寓，仍未拆封。写给配送服务说明误投和定位信息、请求取回或安全纠正，并提供可行交接时间或方式。
解析：范文对照两个公寓号并给运单号，说明未拆封，提出明早可在家或交有人值守的前台，并请确认后再移交。handover 是“交接”。只说地址错了难定位；让包裹随意放走廊也不符合安全要求。
下次：依次写“标签地址与实际地点→运单信息和包裹状态→希望怎样转送→自己能配合的时段或代收点”。不要假定自己必须整天等，也别打开包裹找主人资料。

W91.reference:
Dear Professor Adams,
I have attached an outline for my essay on the preservation of everyday printed materials. My main argument is that surviving library collections do not fully represent what people read in the past, because inexpensive items were often discarded. I plan to compare library catalogs with publishers' records and examples of paper reused in book bindings. My uncertainty is whether this comparison is too broad for the assignment length. Could you advise whether I should focus on one city or one type of printed material? I am seeking guidance on the scope rather than a detailed edit at this stage. Thank you for helping me develop a manageable and well-supported argument.
Best regards,
Alex
W91.explanation:
读懂：论文只有初步提纲，你想在写全文前请教，但教师没时间逐处修改。信中概括论点、指出一个具体疑点，并请求能推进写作的聚焦建议。
解析：范文先说廉价印刷品易丢失，使现存馆藏不能代表过去全部阅读，再指出比较材料范围可能太广，问该聚焦一个城市还是一类印刷品。scope 是“讨论范围”。只附提纲让老师看看，没说明最需要的帮助。
下次：用一句话写主张，再说准备靠什么证据支持，接着只问一个阻碍成稿的选择。明确需要的是范围或论证建议，而非整篇代改，让教师能简短而有效地回复。

W92.reference:
Dear Café Manager,
I would like to suggest displaying a clear ingredient list for the prepared sandwiches beside the menu. Students currently need to ask staff about each item, which can slow the lunch queue and make it difficult for people managing dietary restrictions. A short printed list would answer common questions while still directing customers with serious allergies to staff for confirmation. You could trial the display for two weeks using the three most popular sandwiches, then ask employees whether it reduces repeated questions. This would not require changing the food itself, and updates could be made whenever recipes change. Thank you for considering a practical improvement to the ordering experience.
Best regards,
Alex
W92.explanation:
读懂：咖啡店征集小改进，要求说明改什么、哪些顾客怎样受益，并设计有限试行和评估，不是全面重做服务。
解析：范文建议在菜单旁列三明治配料，帮助有饮食限制的顾客并减少排队询问；先选三款试两周，再问员工是否减少重复问题，配方变时更新。ingredient list 是“配料表”。范文仍让严重过敏者向员工确认，不把简表当安全保证。
下次：按“一个改动→明确受益群体→为何有用→小范围试多久→用什么观察判效果”写。避免只说服务会更好，或提出与有限资源不符的大装修。

W93.reference:
Hi Jordan,
I wanted to check whether our current study schedule still works for you. We missed the last two Tuesday sessions, and I waited at the library because I did not know your plans had changed. I understand that coursework can become unexpectedly busy. Could you let me know whether a different day or a shorter session would be easier? I would be happy to meet online for forty minutes on Thursday instead. It would also help if we both sent a quick confirmation on the morning of each meeting. I value studying together and would like an arrangement that is realistic for both of us. Let me know what you think.
Best,
Alex
W93.explanation:
读懂：学习搭档多次爽约，影响你的准备，但原因未知。写信说明影响、开放询问对方情况，再提出双方可讨论的新安排。
解析：范文具体说在图书馆白等，询问原时间是否仍可行，给较短线上会面及当天互相确认的办法，保留关系而非指责。without making assumptions 是“不先认定原因”。可以体谅忙碌，但不能直接断言对方不重视学习或故意失约。
下次：依次写“哪几次没见成、影响什么→问当前困难→一个可调整方案→请对方反馈”。把确认约见的责任设为双方共同承担，比只要求对方承诺永不迟到更容易执行。

W94.reference:
Dear Ms. Patel,
Thank you again for lending the historical maps to our student exhibition. The department has asked whether the display could remain open for visiting school groups next week, so I am writing to request a short extension of the loan. We would return the maps on Friday, October 23, rather than this Friday. They would remain in the same locked display case under the agreed lighting conditions. If you need the originals back on the original date, we can remove them and use labeled reproductions for the extra week instead. Please let me know which arrangement you prefer. We appreciate your generosity and will respect the return date that works for you.
Best regards,
Alex
W94.explanation:
读懂：学生展览想延长，但借来的材料原定该还。给物主说明延期原因、新归还日期与保管措施，并提供必须按时还原件时的替代方案。
解析：范文以接待学校团体为由，提出延借地图，继续锁柜和原照明条件；如物主要原件，就按时还并用标明为复制品的材料续展。loan 是“借用”，不是购买。只说展览重要而不谈物主需要和保管，会遗漏关键义务。
下次：写“为何多展几天→明确改到哪天归还→仍怎样保护材料→不同意就用什么替代”。先请求许可，不能把延期写成已经决定，也不必照搬范文日期。

W95.reference:
Dear Professor Gomez,
I was unable to attend yesterday's seminar because I was ill, and I am sorry to have missed my scheduled presentation. I have completed the slides and supporting notes and would like to arrange a make-up opportunity. Could I present at the beginning of next Tuesday's class, or during an office-hour appointment if class time is limited? I would also like to know how to complete the question-and-answer component so that I meet the same requirements as the other students. I can send the slides now and provide the absence documentation requested by the department. Thank you for considering an arrangement that lets me complete the work responsibly.
Best regards,
Alex
W95.explanation:
读懂：因病错过已排定的课堂展示，材料已准备好。给教师简述缺席、提出补做时间或方式，并问如何达到与同学相同的要求。
解析：范文提出下次课开头或办公时间展示，特别询问问答环节如何补齐，愿先发幻灯片并提供规定的证明。make-up presentation 是“补做展示”。只求交幻灯片代替全部考核，可能漏掉展示和问答要求；不要默认因病就免除它们。
下次：按“缺席原因与歉意→已准备材料→两个可协调安排→尚需满足哪些环节”写。请求教师确认方案，责任重点是完成同等任务而不是要求特殊成绩。

W96.reference:
Hi team,
I think we should revise the survey question that asks whether students find campus transport cheap and reliable. Those are two separate issues, so someone might agree about the price but disagree about punctuality. A single answer would be difficult to interpret. Could we split it into two questions, one about affordability and another about whether services arrive when expected? We could then test the revised wording with three classmates before sending the survey more widely. This small check should reveal whether the response options are clear without delaying our schedule. I have added a suggested version to the shared draft and would appreciate your comments before tomorrow afternoon.
Best,
Alex
W96.explanation:
读懂：问卷一道题把可能被不同评价的两个想法混在一起。给组员指出哪题与解释问题、建议清晰改写，并提发放前的小检查。
解析：范文把公交“便宜且可靠”拆开：受访者可能认同价格却不认同准时，单一答案无法解释，于是分问可负担程度和准点情况，再找三位同学试答。wording 是“措辞”。只说问题太长而没拆清含义，未解决核心。
下次：先举一种会给两个不同判断的受访者，再分别写两道只问一件事的问题，最后说明找谁试、看能否理解选项。别把小范围试答夸成已证明整个调查有效。

W97.reference:
Dear Seminar Organizer,
My registration confirmation lists the afternoon session on research ethics, but I selected the morning session when completing the form. My confirmation number is RE204, and the registration was submitted on Monday. I have a required class beginning at two, so attending the afternoon session would mean missing part of the discussion. Could you check whether the morning booking can be restored? If it is now full, please place me on its waiting list and let me know whether an equivalent session is planned later in the month. I am keen to complete the training before starting my project. Thank you for helping resolve the scheduling mismatch.
Best regards,
Alex
W97.explanation:
读懂：研讨会确认信列错场次，新列时段与你的安排冲突。写信定位报名、说明原选场次与时间限制，请求纠正并询问必要的备选。
解析：范文给确认号和报名日期，对照原选上午、收到下午，说明必修课冲突，再求恢复上午或候补及之后同等场次。confirmation 是“确认通知”，不是必须接受的不可更改结果。只要求取消会偏离仍希望完成培训的目的。
下次：按“报名记录→我选的与信上列的差异→无法参加的具体原因→首选纠正与满员备选”写。请组织者查明，不先认定是谁操作错误，也不要擅自改别人名额。

W98.reference:
Dear Department Coordinator,
Several students in our class would like to hold a peer workshop on organizing references for research papers. We have experience with the library's recommended software and could demonstrate a simple workflow before helping participants practice with their own sources. May we use a small computer room for one hour next Wednesday afternoon? We would limit attendance to twelve students, circulate preparation instructions beforehand, and leave the room ready for the next class. The workshop would supplement the library's formal training rather than replace it, and we would direct technical questions to library staff. Please let me know whether a suitable room is available and if we need to complete a booking form.
Best regards,
Alex
W98.explanation:
读懂：学生想办短时同伴技能工作坊，需要院系批准房间。写明主题与对象、所需场地时间，并说明怎样负责任地组织。
解析：范文以整理研究引用为主题，请一小时机房，限制十二人、提前发准备说明、用后复原，并说明只是补充图书馆正式培训，复杂问题交工作人员。peer workshop 是“同学之间带领的练习课”。只报活动名称不说明管理，很难获批。
下次：写“教什么、给谁→为何需这种房间、何时用多久→人数和准备→秩序、清理与问题处理”。把请求和管理承诺配套，不假设同伴经验等同于专业支持。

W99.reference:
Dear Professor Singh,
While reviewing the sampling handout, I noticed that the percentages in the table on page three add up to 110 rather than 100. I may be misunderstanding the categories, but the text appears to describe them as mutually exclusive groups. Could you clarify whether one figure contains a typing error or whether respondents were allowed to select more than one category? I am using this example to prepare for the problem set and want to apply the method correctly. If a correction is needed, a short note on the course page might also help classmates who have begun their revision. Thank you for checking the example and explaining the intended interpretation.
Best regards,
Alex
W99.explanation:
读懂：课堂讲义例子可能有错，也可能是你误解。写信定位问题、说明自己的推理，并求澄清或更正以继续完成作业。
解析：范文指出表格百分比合计为一百一十，而文字像在说互不重叠的组别，于是问是笔误还是可以多选，而非断言教师算错。mutually exclusive 是“不能同时属于两个类别”。如果类别可重叠，总和超百本身未必错误。
下次：用“第几页哪个例子→我按什么理解发现冲突→还有哪种解释可能→请确认应怎样用”组织。既具体又留余地，不只说看不懂，也不未经核实要求宣布错误。

W100.reference:
Dear Library Events Team,
I would like to propose a small event called Reading Our Neighborhood Through Old Maps. It would be suitable for teenagers and adults interested in local history, with no prior knowledge required. Participants could compare copies of maps from different decades and discuss how roads, public spaces, and place names changed. The library would need a meeting room, printed map copies, and a projector for the introduction. I could help prepare a simple worksheet and guide the discussion alongside a staff member. Using reproductions would protect the originals while allowing people to annotate their observations. Please let me know whether this idea fits your community program and how I could develop it further.
Best regards,
Alex
W100.explanation:
读懂：向本地图书馆提社区活动，须说明面向谁、目的是什么、参与者具体做什么，以及所需物资和组织支持。
解析：范文让青少年及成人比较不同时代的社区地图，讨论道路和地名变化；列会议室、复制地图、投影仪，并由写信人与员工共同带领。reproductions 是“复制品”，能便于标注又保护原件。只报活动名或泛说增进交流，无法判断可行性。
下次：按“目标人群与收获→两步现场活动→场地材料→我负责什么、需馆方帮什么”写。选择不同主题也可以，但资源应与动作对应，不能默认可以让参与者直接涂写馆藏原件。

W101.reference:
Dear Housing Office,
Repair work outside my residence room has been producing loud drilling noise during the afternoon. I understand that the work is necessary, but I have a scheduled online practice assessment on Thursday from two to three and need to hear spoken prompts clearly. Could you tell me whether drilling is planned during that period? If it cannot be paused, is there a quiet room elsewhere in the residence complex that I could reserve for an hour? I can bring my own laptop and headphones, so I only need a desk and a stable internet connection. Advance information would let me prepare without interfering with the repair team's work. Thank you for your help.
Best regards,
Alex
W101.explanation:
读懂：宿舍维修噪声影响线上考试准备，但维修可能必要。写给住宿办公室说明冲突、询问施工安排，并请求能安心练习的实际办法。
解析：范文给出听力练习的具体一小时，先问是否会钻孔，再提若不能暂停可借安静房间，自带电脑耳机，只需桌子和稳定网络。uninterrupted 是“不受打断的”。只要求整项工程停工，没有考虑维修需要，也没提供可协调条件。
下次：按“什么噪声影响哪项准备→必须安静的时段→请确认维修表→替代房间需什么”写。不要擅称施工违规，重点是提前获得安排而非泛泛投诉。

W102.reference:
Dear Community Garden Coordinator,
I am completing a course project on how use of public spaces changes across the year. Would your organization be willing to share monthly totals of garden visits from the past year, if those figures are already available? I do not need names, contact information, or individual attendance records. The project would compare broad seasonal patterns and discuss how opening hours may affect participation. I would clearly acknowledge the source and any limitations you identify, such as changes in counting methods. After the course, I would be happy to send a short summary of the findings for your own planning. Please let me know whether this request is feasible without creating extra work for your team.
Best regards,
Alex
W102.explanation:
读懂：课程项目想借用本地机构已有信息，但不需要个人档案，也不想增加工作人员负担。说明项目和所需数据、排除身份信息，并愿署明来源、分享有用结果。
解析：范文请求已有的全年每月花园访问总数，用于季节比较，明确不要姓名或个人签到，接受计数方法等限制，愿回传简报。non-identifying data 是“不含可识别个人信息的数据”。不能只说研究用途就索取全部记录。
下次：具体写所需时间范围和汇总层级，说明如何使用、哪些个人信息不必给，再问现有资料是否方便分享。承诺承认来源与局限，不把对方变成免费做新统计的助手。

W103.reference:
Hi Morgan,
Would you like to review the ecology material together before next week's quiz? I suggest meeting in the library collaboration area on Friday at three for about an hour. We could each prepare three questions that require explanations rather than simple definitions, then take turns answering without looking at our notes. Afterward, we could check the textbook and discuss any gaps. I can focus on plant-soil interactions if you would like to prepare questions about pollination networks. This should keep the session focused and give us both a chance to practice retrieval. If Friday does not work, let me know another time over the weekend that suits you.
Best,
Alex
W103.explanation:
读懂：测验前邀请同学一起复习，要交代目标、可协调的时间地点，以及双方各准备什么，不能只是问一起学习吗。
解析：范文提出一小时生态复习，各带三道需解释的问题，轮流脱稿回答后查书补缺，并分担植物土壤与传粉主题，允许改约周末。prepare 指“提前准备”。只定见面地点却没有分工，可能让会面缺少重点。
下次：写“为哪次测验解决什么→何时何地约多久→我准备哪块、你准备哪块→现场怎样用材料”。让同学有调整时间的余地，复习问题要服务找知识漏洞，而不只是聊天。

W104.reference:
Dear Registration Support,
I registered for the undergraduate research conference yesterday and appear to have been charged the registration fee twice. Both charges are for thirty dollars and were recorded within a few minutes of each other. My registration reference is UR619, and I received only one confirmation email. Could you check the payment record and refund the duplicate charge if it has been processed? I have attached a receipt showing the transaction dates and amounts, with unrelated account information removed. Please keep my conference place active, since I still intend to attend and present my poster. Let me know if you need another reference to locate the payments. Thank you for resolving the duplicate transaction.
Best regards,
Alex
W104.explanation:
读懂：会议报名费似乎被扣了两次，你只报一次而仍要参加。给支持人员说明重复记录与报名信息、提供支付线索，并请求纠正且保留名额。
解析：范文给报名号、两笔金额和相近时间，提供遮去无关信息的收据，请核实后退重复款，明确不取消会议和海报展示。duplicate charge 是“重复扣费”，不等于要求退全部费用。漏说继续参会，容易造成误会。
下次：按“哪份报名→两笔交易日期金额→可供核查的凭据→退重复一笔、保留报名”写。只提供必要资料，不公开完整账户信息，也不在核实前断言对方故意收费。

W105.reference:
Dear Facilities Team,
Visitors to the language center often enter through the main doors and then struggle to find the reception desk, which is around the corner on the lower level. I have helped several new students who assumed the building was unstaffed because the first corridor looked empty. Could you install a simple directional sign opposite the entrance and another beside the lift? Including the accessible route would help visitors who cannot use the stairs. A temporary printed sign could test whether the wording and position work before permanent signs are ordered. Clearer directions would save staff repeated interruptions and make the building easier to use. Thank you for considering this suggestion.
Best regards,
Alex
W105.explanation:
读懂：校内建筑某处分流指示不清，访客找不到重要服务。写给设施团队定位困惑点、说明谁怎样迷路，并提出清楚且放对位置的标牌。
解析：范文说明语言中心接待台在转角下层，新生见走廊空就以为无人值守，建议门对面和电梯旁设方向牌、标无障碍路线，先用临时纸牌试位置与措辞。directional sign 是“方向指示牌”。只写多加标牌，不说明去哪和放哪，难执行。
下次：依照访客真实路线写“从哪里进→在哪一步判断错→目标在哪里→哪两处指示能引导”。让试行能检验方向是否清楚，而非只换好看的牌子。

W106.reference:
Hi team,
After reviewing our project plan, I think the data-analysis section may require considerably more time than the introduction and formatting tasks. At present, one person is responsible for all the analysis, which could create a bottleneck near the deadline. Could we divide it into data checking and interpretation, with two people working together? I can take responsibility for checking the spreadsheet and documenting any corrections, while another member drafts the explanation of the findings. We could then review the introduction and final formatting as a group. Please share your availability before we agree on changes so the workload remains fair. I hope this adjustment will make our final week more manageable.
Best,
Alex
W106.explanation:
读懂：项目当前分工已不均衡，需在临近截止前与队友商量。信中指出担忧、提出具体公平分配，并邀请按各人时间与长处调整。
解析：范文说明数据分析比引言和排版耗时，单人负责会成进度瓶颈，建议拆成核查数据与解释结果，自己承担表格核查，最后全组复审其他工作。bottleneck 是“拖住整体进度的瓶颈”。公平不是每人任务名称数量一样。
下次：写“哪项工作量变重→如何拆成明确产出→我接哪部分→请大家报时间并协商”。不要指责某人偷懒或未经同意分派，理由应围绕任务负担和完成进度。

W107.reference:
Dear Ms. Brown,
Thank you for the practical advice you gave me during last week's interview workshop. Your suggestion to prepare one specific example for each major skill helped me organize my answers much more clearly. In yesterday's internship interview, I described how our project group recovered from a missed deadline instead of simply saying that I work well with others. The interviewer asked a useful follow-up question, and I felt better able to explain my own contribution. I still need to make my opening answers shorter, so I plan to practice with a friend and time each response. I appreciate your guidance and wanted you to know how directly it helped my preparation.
Best regards,
Alex
W107.explanation:
读懂：导师曾给面试建议，你已实践。写信感谢并点明建议、说明怎样使用和产生什么效果，再交代下一步计划。
解析：范文把每项能力配具体例子的建议用于讲小组补救错过截止日的经历，比只说善合作更清楚；结果是能回答追问，而不是宣称已拿到实习，随后计划计时练更简短的开头。follow-up question 是“追问”。只感谢有帮助会显得空泛。
下次：按“哪条建议→面试中一个实际用法→你观察到的改善→还想练什么”写。把已发生的效果与未知录用结果分开，不用为了感谢编造成功结局。

W108.reference:
Dear Course Team,
The recording of Monday's guest lecture is very useful, but several sections are difficult to follow because the microphone is faint and technical terms are unfamiliar. Could captions or a checked transcript be added to the video? This would help students review the terminology accurately and make the material easier to access in different listening conditions. If a full transcript takes time, sharing the speaker's slides and a list of key terms would be a helpful temporary alternative. I can identify the timestamps where the sound is especially unclear if that assists the process. Thank you for making the lecture available and for considering ways to improve its usability.
Best regards,
Alex
W108.explanation:
读懂：课程视频没有字幕很难跟上，但你仍想完成学习。给课程团队说明困难、请求字幕或适当支持，并提字幕暂时做不出时的替代材料。
解析：范文说声音弱、术语不熟，求字幕或核查过的文字稿，暂时可给幻灯片与词表，并愿标出听不清的时间点。captions 是“视频字幕”，transcript 是“文字稿”。只要求免看视频就失去保留学习内容的目的。
下次：先定位听不清或难懂的部分，再说明哪种支持能解决它，最后给保留关键内容的临时替代。不要把未核对的自动文字当绝对准确，重点是帮助理解原讲座。

W109.reference:
Dear Workshop Manager,
Our materials class is studying how repair decisions can extend the useful life of everyday objects. Would it be possible for a small group of six students to visit your bicycle workshop for a brief explanation of how staff assess damaged parts? We are interested in the decision process rather than observing customers or interrupting repairs. A twenty-minute visit before opening or during another quiet period would be sufficient. We would follow all safety instructions and would not take photographs without permission. If a visit is impractical, a short online conversation would also be valuable. Please let us know whether either option might fit your schedule. Thank you for considering our request.
Best regards,
Alex
W109.explanation:
读懂：班级想短访本地机构了解实际工作，又不能干扰营业。写给经理说明学习目的、人数时长等有限安排，并表示尊重限制和愿协调。
解析：范文以六名学生了解自行车零件维修判断为目标，只求安静时段二十分钟讲解，不观察顾客、不未经许可拍照，若不便则线上交流。operational constraints 是“日常运营限制”。不能只说参观有趣却默认可自由进出工作区。
下次：按“想学哪种工作决策→多少人、多久、做什么→选择低干扰时间→遵守安全与替代方式”写。把学习问题缩小，便于负责人判断是否能安排。

W110.reference:
Dear Academic Adviser,
The new timetable places the required statistics tutorial and the environmental methods laboratory at the same time on Thursday mornings. Both courses are listed as necessary for my program this semester, and missing either regularly would prevent me from completing the practical work. Could you advise whether another tutorial group is available or whether the department plans to adjust the schedule? I checked the registration portal, but the only alternative statistics group currently appears full. I would prefer to resolve the overlap before classes begin rather than alternate absences.
